content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that loads a first free-surface grid to establish dimensions (L8-L14), constructs a piecewise flat/sloping bed profile (L16-L22), then loads 99 eta/mask frame pairs, masks dry cells, renders a mesh and center-row transect, rasterizes each figure, and writes an MPEG-4 video (L40-L83).

script parameters SLP, Xslp, DEPTH_FLAT defined at L4-L6
eta loaded at L8 and reassigned at L43
grid dimensions n and m defined at L10
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L11-L12
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L13-L14
loop index i defined at L16
bed vector dep assigned at L18 and L20
frame-number vector nfile defined at L24
VideoWriter object myVideo defined at L26
myVideo.FrameRate and myVideo.Quality assigned at L27-L28
vidHeight and vidWidth defined at L29-L30
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L34-L35
frame loop variable num defined at L40
formatted frame suffix fnum defined at L42
captured RGB image F defined at L76
resized frame J defined at L77
movie frame field mov(num).cdata assigned at L78

equations.ref: uniform x coordinates from column count and dx
uniform y coordinates from row count and dy
sloping-bed branch at and beyond Xslp
resize captured RGB frame to video dimensions

calls: load at L8, L43, and L44
unresolved: Potential out-of-range index across L10 and L57: if a loaded eta grid has n=1, floor(n/2) is 0, which is not a valid MATLAB index; no minimum-row check is present.

Cross-file/frame consistency is unchecked across L8-L14 and L43-L46: subsequent eta and mask files are assumed to exist and to match the initial eta dimensions, while a size mismatch can break mask assignment or plotting.
The fixed nfile range at L24 drives unconditional reads at L40-L44; the script does not test whether all 99 eta/mask pairs exist.
